audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart layers disagreed: full phases[3..6].side (Irelia/Skill/Skill/Skill) vs content win[3..6] (Vladimir/Irelia/Irelia/Vladimir). Packet levelChart matches the content layer.
audit.why: Content layer and packet agree; full layer carried stale sides and a phases[4]/[5].why arguing the opposite verdict to win[4]/[5].
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to match content/packet; whys rewritten to match each verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: Enemy misgendered in 18 fields; breakdown.cooldowns had no numbers; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were tradeGood/tradeBad pasted verbatim; enemyWin was a template.
audit.why: Irelia is she/her (champ-gender.js). Real numbers exist in the kit: E 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, Q 10-6s with resets, R 125/105/85s, Vlad W 28-16s.
audit.corrected: All pronoun fixes applied, cooldowns field now carries real numbers, bleed bullets rewritten to match their titles, enemyWin grounded in her Q-reset/E-stun pattern.

audit.why: Missing-interaction flag (Irelia sustains through Bladesurge, anti-heal timing matters) is already covered by report[8].t 'Add anti-heal early into her sustain' after pronoun fix.
